author: IGN
description:
Did you know GTA 6 has four fully playable video games hidden within Leonida? From a zombie survival shooter to a mysterious indie horror puzzle game, Grand Theft Auto 6 lets you take a break from crime and chaos to enjoy some games within the game! Here's a look at all four playable video games in GTA 6 and where you can find them.

In this guide, we'll show you Street Trash Dezombifier 3, Tenebrae Lux, Time Jackers: Rewind, and Bang for Your Buck. Three of these games can be played using the JoySystem at your safehouse, while Bang for Your Buck can be found at arcade locations like the Rusty Anchor. Whether you're hunting zombies, solving puzzles, or shooting bucks, there's plenty to keep you entertained when you're not causing trouble across Leonida.

For more GTA 6 tips, secrets, Easter eggs, and walkthroughs, stay tuned to IGN!
https://www.ign.com/wikis/gta-6
title: GTA 6 Has 4 In-Game Video Games You Can Actually Play!

description:
In today's Daily Fix:
As if anyone expected anything different, GTA 6 now has the biggest launch in entertainment history with a staggering $3.79 billion in sales in its first 24 hours. This includes more than 30 million pre-sale copies sold. And keep in mind, the PC version has yet to drop. Although GTA 6's launch dwarfs even the biggest movie releases, it's not a true 1:1 comparison as the game sells for about $80 a copy ($100 if you buy the ultimate edition), and your average movie ticket is nowhere near that expensive. In related news, prior to the launch of GTA 6, gamers spent 14% less this October than last year, despite heavy hitters like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and the Ocarina of Time remake dropping in the same month. This is likely due to the GTA 6 effect, and gamers wanting to save their time and money for that game instead. description:
Mandy might be one of the most disturbing characters in Grand Theft Auto 6. What starts as a simple rent collection mission for Jason quickly turns into something much darker. From a possible severed human finger hidden in her sink to suspicious tools, acid, and a freshly dug grave behind her house, there are plenty of clues suggesting Mandy could secretly be a serial killer.
 
In this GTA 6 video, we break down all the disturbing evidence surrounding Mandy, including her strange behavior during the Pipework mission, the suspicious contents of her car, her obsession with stalking ex-boyfriends on Snapmatic, and some particularly unsettling text messages. Is Mandy really one of GTA 6's most dangerous NPCs, or are we reading too much into the clues? Let us know what you think in the comments!

author: IGN
description:
GTA 6 doesn't feature a proper first-person camera... Yet! But that hasn't stopped players from discovering a potential camera glitch in Grand Theft Auto 6, allowing anyone to enter into 1st person mode! This sneaky bug is easy to reproduce and is still in the launch version of GTA VI! Don't worry, this secret first-person mode works on both the PS5 and Xbox versions of Grand Theft Auto VI.
Here are the steps:
1) Enter GTA 6’s Settings menu.
2) Use the bumpers to move across to the ‘CONTROLLER’ tab.
3) Scroll down to ‘Touch Pad Button’ or ‘View Button’.
4) Change it from ‘Map’ to ‘Camera’.
5) Enter a car.
6) Bring up your phone using the d-pad.
7) Press either the Circle or B button to put your phone away while spamming the 'Camera' button. Repeat these steps until first-person mode is locked in!
title: How to Play GTA 6 in First-Person (It's a Glitch!)
